title: AI Based Web Designing – Professional
subtitle: 6 months · 24 weeks · Professional / Advanced
summary: Develop professional UX research, UI design and real-world project skills: user research, interviews, personas, information architecture, usability studies, high-fidelity design, prototyping, accessibility and professional case studies.
expert: At the end you can run a complete UX/UI process, from research to a tested high-fidelity prototype, and present it as a professional case study.

benchmarks.title: Research
benchmarks.detail: Plan and conduct UX research, conduct user interviews and develop personas.

benchmarks.title: Structure
benchmarks.detail: Create information architecture, sitemaps and user flows.

benchmarks.title: Testing
benchmarks.detail: Conduct usability studies and synthesise findings with affinity mapping.

benchmarks.title: Design
benchmarks.detail: Create high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes, applying accessibility and ethical design.

benchmarks.title: Portfolio
benchmarks.detail: Develop professional UX/UI case studies and portfolio projects.
